payload.text: Carry::discount_df(t) is a pure function computing the numeraire discount factor e^{-r*t} via libm::exp(-self.discount_rate() * t). It has no side effects and no state mutation — its output depends only on (self, t). Because discount_rate() reads r_dom verbatim for Carry::FxRates, the FX discount factor produced here is byte-identical to VanillaInputs::df_dom (the FX two-rate form), preserving FX bit-identity across the carry seam (ADR-0008). CarryInputs::discount_df and ExoticInputs::discount_df both delegate to this method.
